0.original: The House Manderville artisan stands ready to facilitate your augmentation request.<hex:02100103>※Changing classes or jobs will prevent progress during this quest.

1.original: You approach the House Manderville artisan with a request to augment a different Manderville weapon. The ever-enthusiastic craftsman asks only that you supply him with the necessary chunks of complementary chondrite─a substance which is, of course, only available from a particular merchant for a very particular type of currency.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※You may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Chunks of complementary chondrite can be obtained from Jubrunnah at the aetheryte plaza in Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han.

2.original: You make the required meteoritic contribution, and are once more blessed to witness a collaboration of artisanal brilliance. Encouraged by Gerolt's grudging praise, the House Manderville artisan bids you call upon him again should you have other armaments you wish to have augmented.

49.original: Please ensure you have changed to your desired job before speaking with the House Manderville artisan.

51.original: Undertake this quest as another job.

53.original: Please speak with the House Manderville artisan again when you are ready to undertake this quest.

54.original: You have already received <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203> and <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E803020203>. Please change to a different job and speak with the House Manderville artisan again.

55.original: You have already received <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>. Please change to a different job and speak with the House Manderville artisan again.

56.original: In order to accept the quest “The Next Mander-level,” please ensure that <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203> and <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E803020203> are either equipped, in your Armoury Chest, or in your inventory.

57.original: In order to accept the quest “The Next Mander-level,” please ensure that <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203> is either equipped, in your Armoury Chest, or in your inventory.

58.original: Am I free to perform an augmentation? Why, certainly, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>!

59.original: You need but contribute the necessary quantity of complementary chondrite, and we can elevate your Manderville weaponry to the next Mander-level, ahahaha! Ahem. Three chunks, if you please.

60.original: Chunks of complementary chondrite can be obtained from Jubrunnah at the aetheryte plaza in Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han.

61.original: Yes, that would be <hex:021A020203>three<hex:021A020103> chunks of complementary chondrite, I'm afraid. We wouldn't wish to upset the delicate balance of your armaments with an unproven ratio now, would we?

62.original: Chunks of complementary chondrite can be obtained from Jubrunnah at the aetheryte plaza in Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han.

63.original: <sniff> Is that chondrite I smell? Splendid! If you would be so kind as to unbuckle your weaponry...?

65.original: Very good. As for my inner fires, I assure you that they burn hotter than Master Gerolt's furnace. Let us bring the blacksmith and his hammer to bear, shall we?

66.original: ...An' done! What do ye think o' that, eh?

69.original: Another collaborative triumph, Master Gerolt! I feel the more I work at your side, the closer I come towards achieving true mastery!

70.original: Hah! Don't be daft, ye trouser-less twit! I've seen better craftsmen in a goblin's nursery!

71.original: An' while we're yappin', his lordship made ye do the same “martial meditation” as me, didn't he? What'd he have ye fight, then?

72.original: I locked tusks, as it were, with a furious gaja of Saltwind's Welcome.

73.original: Y-Ye mean one o' them huge stompin' brutes!? An' ye took it down!?

74.original: Yes, though I barely survived with my smallclothes intact...

75.original: D-Did ye, now...? <cough> Might be as I was exaggeratin' a bit earlier. Yer a credit to yer craft, so keep at it, all right?

77.original: A superlative result as usual, Master Gerolt! I could ask for no finer example to aspire to in my own pursuit of perfection!

78.original: Aye, when ye've got the gift like I have, ye can fix up any weapon ye put yer hand to! ...Ye did help a little, o' course.

79.original: There you have it, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. Should you have further need of our augmentation services, we are at your beck and call.

80.original: All we require is a handful of chondrite and a few moments of your time!
